pages.quiz:
COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

2. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.
   C. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

4. Which statement about Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr as rumours only.
   C. Say Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

6. Which statement about Self- Awareness in the Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self- Awareness in the Community as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Awareness in the Community.
   C. Say Self- Awareness in the Community never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

8. Which statement about Conflict Resolution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Conflict Resolution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Conflict Resolution never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution.
   D. Treat Conflict Resolution as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Concept of Community Service Learning is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Concept of Community Service Learning.
   B. Say Concept of Community Service Learning never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Concept of Community Service Learning with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Concept of Community Service Learning as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp as rumours only.
   B. Say Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp.
   D. Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Intercultural competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Intercultural competence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Intercultural competence as rumours only.
   C. Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural competence.

12. Which statement about Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision.
   D. Explain Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Awareness in the Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Conflict Resolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Responsible Decision Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. A — Explain symbols used on a map

5. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

6. D — Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A — Plan income and spending wisely

8. A — Explain Conflict Resolution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. C — Explain Concept of Community Service Learning with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. D — Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. C — Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. D — Explain Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Self- Awareness in the Community; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Conflict Resolution; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Responsible Decision Making; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
